reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, keeping this consistent with the OpenAI approach in #1869 makes both backends easy to reason about.

Checked at `26a11b2`: the retry only fires on a 400 that names `temperature`, `top_p` or `top_k`, it happens once, and resetting the three fields to the zero `param.Opt` values leaves them out of the second body (the test checks all three). The `max_tokens is too large` case is returned after a single call. It's limited to `GetCompletion`, so it doesn't overlap #1844. CI is green.

Small optional cleanup: `apiErr.Error()` also includes the request URL and raw body, so matching on the error's message field alone would be a little tighter. Not needed for this one.

Good to merge.
